title: Listening: News Briefs
description: Listen to short invented news reports about weather, local events, science and sports, and answer a question.

questions.prompt: Listen. What weather is expected tomorrow afternoon?

media.text: Enjoy the sunshine while it lasts. Forecasters say heavy rain and strong winds will arrive tomorrow afternoon and continue into the weekend.

questions.explanation: The forecast says the sunshine ends tomorrow afternoon with heavy rain and strong winds.

questions.prompt: Listen. Why is Maple Street closed this Saturday?

media.text: Maple Street will be closed to traffic from nine to noon this Saturday for the town's annual spring parade. Drivers are asked to use Oak Avenue instead.

questions.explanation: The brief says the street closes for the annual spring parade.

questions.prompt: Listen. What did the scientists discover?

media.text: Researchers exploring a remote rainforest have identified a tiny new species of frog. It's smaller than a fingernail and has bright orange spots.

questions.explanation: The report says researchers found a frog species that had never been described before.

questions.prompt: Listen. What was the final score?

media.text: In last night's soccer final, the Hillport Hawks came from behind to beat the Riverside Rovers three to two, with the winning goal in the final minute.

questions.explanation: The Hillport Hawks came from behind to win three to two.

questions.prompt: Listen. What is the library offering?

media.text: The Central Library will offer free coding workshops for teenagers aged thirteen to seventeen this summer. Spaces are limited, so sign up early.

questions.explanation: The library is offering free coding workshops for teens aged thirteen to seventeen.

questions.prompt: Listen. Why was the flight delayed?

media.text: Several morning flights out of Lakeview Airport were delayed by up to two hours today because thick fog reduced visibility on the runways.

questions.explanation: The brief says flights were delayed because thick fog reduced visibility.

questions.prompt: Listen. How long did the swimmer swim?

media.text: A local swimmer has crossed Silver Lake in record time. She reached the far shore after twelve hours in the water, beating the old record by forty minutes.

questions.explanation: The report says she reached the shore after twelve hours in the water.

questions.prompt: Listen. What will the new park include?

media.text: The city council has approved plans for a new park on the east side of town. It will include a large playground and a community garden, and should open next spring.

options.text: A swimming pool and a café
A playground and a community garden
A skate park and a parking lot

questions.explanation: The city plans a park with a playground and a community garden.
